On 2026-08-16, zone a51cd0a6-a6ca-4104-80d8-f1e5cf74ee6e was created through the production API, assigned to the connected phone user, registered by Google Play Services at 100m, and acknowledged by the backend as needsSync=false. decisions.decision: Created a fresh production API zone assigned to the signed-in phone user rather than member guts
decisions.rationale: The connected phone was signed in as Guardian mohh; registration only occurs for the assigned member, so assigning the zone to the actual connected-device user exercises native registration on the available phone.

decisions.decision: Fixed WorkManager headless entrypoint by exposing geofenceBackgroundMain from main.dart
decisions.rationale: Physical-device logs showed the previous entrypoint could not be resolved and the root isolate could not start, which would block authenticated candidate upload.
